property_summary: For any sender and any positive ETH value, executing receive() always increases depositsCount by 1 (so after a call depositsCount == prior + 1); the mutant prevents any deposit once depositsCount is nonzero, so performing two sequential positive-value receives from the same sender will leave the mutant's depositsCount unchanged on the second call while the reference increments it.
change_summary: Replace the require condition with a failing condition that prevents depositsCount increment when depositsCount is nonzero (changes observable post-receive state).
